description: Randomized golf progression for Mario Golf: Toadstool Tour.

v1.0.4.description:
This update attempts to fix a number of user-reported issues with AP logic or reporting, both in the Poptracker and the AP World itself. The included .apworld is compatible with the patch issued in the v1.0.0 release (I've included a copy here for convenience)

- Checks involving achieving a certain round score should now trigger properly
- Course wide "birdie all par _ holes" checks should also trigger properly
- Birdies/Best Badges should now be tracked by Archipelago, and should survive local Best Badge data being deleted
- Glitches where receiving courses triggered tournament accomplishments should be fixed
- Poptracker improvements should allow for better persistence
- Issues with Ring Attack location reporting couldn't be duplicated, but some additional information for diagnostics is now able to be captured through the /mgtt_diagnostics debug command
